Re-derived for #39 on 2026-09-27 by a new independent Decimal script, written without reading the engine, which first reproduced every earlier expected value of this golden under the earlier TGSS rule and then changed only that rule. Actuals are the cumulative closed quarters; the projection is spread evenly over the months after the last of them. TGSS (#39): LGSS art. 308.1.c 1.ª–3.ª (boe.es consolidated RDL 8/2015, read 2026-09-27): rendimiento computable = IRPF rendimiento neto plus the titular's own cuotas (1.ª), less 7 % gastos genéricos (2.ª, config seguridadSocial.gastosGenericos), spread over the months of alta (3.ª). The net is Modelo 100 casilla 0224 and the cuotas casilla 0186 (AEAT, Información para determinar el rendimiento neto, sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es, page updated 18 Sep 2026, read 2026-09-27); casilla 0224 is after difícil justificación (RD 439/2007 art. 30.2ª: 5 %, at most 2,000) and before every LIRPF art. 32 reduction and the other reductions Modelo 100 2025 takes after it, in casillas 0225, 0232–0234 and 0236–0237 (Anexo I, página 9), so the art. 32.3 reduction does not lower it. Casilla 0224 is the year's ingresos less its gastos, the actual ones with the cuotas charged and the projected ones with the projected cuotas, less difícil justificación. Every month's cuota is priced at the highest tramo consistent with the monthly figure it leads to; tarifa plana 80 for the alta month and the twelve complete calendar months after it, Ley 20/2007 art. 38 ter.1 (boe.es consolidated text, read 2026-09-26); the month of alta prorated by days of alta / 30 as MonthlyCuotaCalculator does (#7). Hold-back share (Σ 130 + gap + Σ cuotas SS) / annual ingresos, rounded up to 0.0001. No AEAT simulator, published example or gestor covers a set-aside estimate; this is the weakest gate.
